ConditionalEvent.description:
One event: the entry signal (what was available) and, separately, the outcomes.

In estimated and ex_post modes `signal_cutoff_at` is the moment the signal was
evaluated, `signal_available_at` the instant the information behind it became available
(never later than the cutoff), and `entry_at` the entry price time (never earlier than
the cutoff). `forward_returns` are future outcomes measured after `entry_at`.
